rule_text: grant delete on nodes (d:Document) where d.status = archived to Editor;
deny traverse on relationships (r:OWNS) where r.active = false to Manager;
grant modify{*} on nodes (p:Post) to Moderator;
grant traverse on nodes (a:Account) where a.balance <= 0 to Auditor;
grant modify{*} on nodes (a:Account) to Auditor;
deny modify{balance} on nodes (a:Account) to Auditor;
grant delete on relationships (t:TRANSFER) where t.amount > 10000 to Compliance;
grant modify{*} on relationships (t:TRANSFER) to Compliance;
deny modify{amount} on relationships (t:TRANSFER) to Compliance;
deny modify{salary} on nodes (e:Employee) to HR_Assistant;
grant remove{*} on nodes (e:Employee) to HR_Assistant;
deny modify{date} on relationships (r:REPORTS_TO) to Analyst;
grant remove{*} on relationships (r:REPORTS_TO) to Analyst;
deny modify{*} on nodes (c:Customer) to Support;
grant remove{phone} on nodes (c:Customer) to Support;
deny modify{salary} on nodes (e:Employee) to Payroll_Clerk;
grant remove{salary} on nodes (e:Employee) to Payroll_Clerk;
deny modify{credit_limit} on nodes (a:Account) to Bank_Teller;
grant remove{credit_limit} on nodes (a:Account) to Bank_Teller;
deny modify{role} on nodes (u:User) to IT_Support;
grant remove{role} on nodes (u:User) to IT_Support;
grant read{salary} on nodes (e:Employee) to Payroll_Clerk;
grant read{credit_limit} on nodes (a:Account) to Bank_Teller;
grant read{role} on nodes (u:User) to IT_Support;
